title: Step 5 - Add Sounds to Button Clicks
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: Refactor sound playing into a reusable playSound(name) function.

concepts.heading: Refactor
points: Create playSound(name) taking the colour name.
Move the Audio code from nextSequence into it, building the path as "sounds/" + name + ".mp3".
Call playSound(randomChosenColour) in nextSequence and playSound(userChosenColour) in the click handler.
Same function also serves "wrong" later because wrong.mp3 follows the same naming.

code_examples.caption: playSound

task.name: Extract playSound
task.goal: Both game and user presses play the right sound
steps: Move the audio code there with name in the path
Call it from the click handler
task.expected_result: Clicking green plays green.mp3; the pattern flash plays its colour sound.
